reason: I'd download it and run the free 14-day test since nothing gets charged, but then I'd stay on the free version. It already plays ad-free with the screen off, and that's all I really use YouTube rain sounds for. On my budget, another 4,900 won a month is exactly the kind of thing I cancel.
objection: Phone-on-the-bed tracking that guesses when I fell asleep feels shaky, especially since my bedtime jumps around every week. A couple of minutes' difference over 7 nights each could just be noise, and I'm not sure I'd trust that more than my own feeling.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison showed I clearly fell asleep faster, like 10+ minutes on most nights, I'd take the yearly plan at 39,000 won, since that works out to about 3,250 a month.
